channel.title: 1200km Security Research
channel.description: CTI-to-detection research, AdversaryGraph updates, malware analysis, detection engineering, security labs, and analyst tooling by Andrey Pautov.

item.title: Validate a simulated agent permission boundary
item.description: Test a benign local permission simulator, checking allow and deny decisions, audit completeness and negative controls without live agent privileges.

item.title: Validate a command-shell detection candidate with benign events
item.description: Inspect benign synthetic events and test a command-shell detection candidate, using positive and negative controls to distinguish matches from noise.

item.title: Triage a reproducible benign artifact
item.description: Triage a deterministic benign ZIP using hashes and structured observations, corroborate findings and test negative controls without handling live malware.

item.title: AI in Cyberattacks: A Statistical CTI Study of 111 Publications
item.description: Analyze 111 publications and 103 eligible CTI records mapping attacker use of AI, evidence strength, research limits, datasets, and reproducible methods.

item.title: AdversaryGraph v7.0.0 Validated Source Release
item.description: AdversaryGraph v7.0.0 is merged and CI-validated on main; the latest published immutable GitHub release is v7.0.0. AdversaryGraph main is at v7.0.0, matching the latest published immutable GitHub release. No changes are recorded after the v7.0.0 release boundary.

item.title: Newest Detection Engineering Techniques
item.description: Read a practical guide to modern detection engineering, from telemetry and ATT&CK mapping to detection-as-code, validation, tuning, and analyst handoff.

item.title: Embedded Systems, Hardware, Firmware
item.description: Review source-linked threats to embedded systems, firmware and edge appliances, including persistence, attack surfaces and limits of available evidence.

item.title: From Log to Report: Using AdversaryGraph to Turn Firewall and EDR Noise Into a CTI Investigation
item.description: Follow an AdversaryGraph investigation from firewall and EDR logs to a CTI report, preserving evidence as IOCs are enriched and findings are reviewed.

item.title: Historical: AdversaryGraph v4 Capability Map
item.description: Review historical AdversaryGraph v4 capability map and its investigation workflows, keeping version-specific claims separate from current features.
